groups.title: Heavy Lift & Engineered Marine Operations
groups.summary: We provide engineered lifting solutions for large, complex, and unconventional offshore structures using heavy-lift vessels.
groups.intro: Heavy lifting is a core Xenos capability. We provide engineered lifting solutions for large, complex, and unconventional offshore structures using heavy-lift vessels, crane vessels, specialized rigging, and modular lifting systems.

groups.title: Marine Salvage & Emergency Response
groups.summary: Marine salvage requires a different operating mindset from conventional construction.
groups.intro: Marine salvage requires a different operating mindset from conventional construction. Conditions are often uncertain, engineering information may be incomplete, assets may be damaged or unstable, and operational circumstances can change rapidly.

about.title: People who work freely between trades
text: Xenos is a contracting firm specializing in marine construction, offshore heavy lifting and marine salvage operations.

We hire people who can work freely across trades, because everyone on the team can contribute to the project beyond their given trade. We also value skilled maritime veterans and the discipline and leadership they bring.
Xenos can run an individual scope of work or bring engineering, heavy lift, construction, subsea, diving and salvage together as one complete marine spread.
